lead.caption: A Long March 2F rocket carries Shenzhou-24 skyward from Jiuquan, 08:18 Beijing time.
lead.fact: First Pakistani in orbit • Five-to-ten-day mission
lead.headline: Shenzhou-24 carries first Pakistani into orbit
lead.summary: A Long March 2F lifts off from Jiuquan at 08:18 Beijing time with Tang Hongbo, Wu Yi and Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali — the first foreign astronaut aboard Tiangong. Docking follows about three and a half hours later.

secondary.headline: Huawei vows to appeal after US jury convicts it on 10 counts
secondary.summary: A Brooklyn jury convicts Huawei of fraud, sanctions violations and trade-secret theft; it acquits on racketeering. Verdict: Tuesday, 24 Nov, US time. Sentencing: 14 September 2027.

secondary.headline: Saudi jets hit Hodeidah overnight after Houthi drone strikes Riyadh tower
secondary.summary: Coalition jets bomb Hodeidah after a Houthi drone hit Riyadh's 80-storey PIF Tower, wounding 11 — the second strike in a week. The Houthis threaten Red Sea ports; Britain sanctions them.
